baseline_models.mechanism: The people are named by active self-guarding, while the garden is a tree-made enclosure and protective cover. Their practiced boundary is spatialized as an inhabitable, cultivated shelter.

activation_trace.role: Placing the self in protective caution supplies the inhabitants' active disposition.
A tree-covered enclosure turns inward protection into the architecture of the destination.
Protective covering sharpens the garden as shelter rather than scenery alone.

changed_reading.before: A conventionally pious class is compensated with pleasant gardens.
changed_reading.after: Those who keep placing themselves behind a moral guard enter a living enclosure where protection has become habitat.

baseline_models.mechanism: Proximity is joined to lordship, ownership, and stagewise nurture. The gardens are not merely transferred objects; being held near the One who owns, repairs, and completes is part of the reward.

activation_trace.role: Proximity and presence make 'with/near' a relational location and rank, not a bare coordinate.
Lordship, ownership, and authority identify whose custody gives the location force.
Repair, nurture, and completion make proximity an ongoing relation of care.

changed_reading.before: The gardens are stored at a divine location for later possession.
changed_reading.after: Divine nearness and custody are constitutive of the gardens: the guarded remain under the care that completes place and inhabitant.

baseline_models.mechanism: The garden's vigorous growth meets softness, ease, and the image of a land agreeing with its settler. Bliss can name reciprocal fit between a thriving place and those able to dwell there, not only an inventory of pleasures.

activation_trace.role: Thick, vigorous plant growth supplies a living system rather than a static backdrop.
Softness and easeful living provide the habitat's bodily texture.
A place agreeing with a person supplies the mechanism of inhabitant-place fitness.

changed_reading.before: The genitive 'gardens of bliss' simply intensifies the amount of pleasure.
changed_reading.after: Bliss is durable ecological congruence: vigorous shelter, easeful conditions, and inhabitants for whom the place is fitting.

baseline_models.mechanism: A form-distant guarding branch supplies an animal placing each step to spare an injured hoof. Coupled with an agreeable place, moral caution gains a kinesthetic reading: careful passage over harmful terrain toward settled ease.

activation_trace.role: Guarded movement that spares a painful hoof supplies the careful-gait image.
A place congenial to its settler provides stable arrival after cautious passage.

changed_reading.before: The guarded are an abstract moral category already at rest.
changed_reading.after: They can also be imagined as careful walkers whose restraint preserves footing until they reach terrain suited to dwelling.

context_deltas.mechanism: Verse 68:2 combines favor, Lord, and the mind-covering branch of madness under negation; 68:34 recombines the same roots as Lord, gardens, and bliss. Covering changes from a hostile claim that cognition is veiled into a beneficial enclosure produced by divine favor.

activation_trace.role: Bestowed favor is the earlier force blocking the harmful diagnosis and later naming well-being.
Nurture and completion identify the caring source in both root configurations.
Madness as a veil over the mind supplies the harmful covering explicitly denied.
The tree-covered garden converts the shared covering root into shelter and cultivation.
Pleasant well-being completes the reversal from stigmatizing enclosure to bestowed habitat.

structural_cues: 68:2 negates مَجْنُونٍ through بِنعمة ربك; 68:34 rearranges those roots as ربهم/جنات/النعيم.
The earlier covering is an accusation about a person; the focus covering is a plural place for a people.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies exact root recurrence and opposed branch images; I infer a designed reconfiguration from mind-veiling to shelter. A live alternative is ordinary lexical recurrence without deliberate contrast.

changed_reading.before: The garden image is unrelated to the opening denial of madness.
changed_reading.after: The focus completes a root-level reversal: the Lord's favor does not veil the mind but ultimately gives protective, cultivated covering.

context_deltas.mechanism: Recompense is first described through non-cutting and non-diminution; the garden narrative is then saturated with intended harvest-cutting and actual severance. The focus gardens inherit a temporal contrast with the ruined plot: their bounty is not exhausted by the cut ending a harvest cycle.

activation_trace.role: Recompense for work supplies the earlier reward frame into which the focus gardens enter.
Cutting and diminution until extension ends make the negated reward explicitly unsevered.
Palm-harvest cutting supplies the owners' intended terminal extraction.
Cutting and separation make the garden bear the condition intended for its fruit.
Plural cultivated enclosures provide the contrasting garden state.

structural_cues: 68:3 announces undiminished recompense before 68:17-32 narrates a garden organized around cutting.
68:34 follows the ruined owners' punishment generalized in 68:33.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies reward, non-cutting, and repeated garden-cutting; I carry the earlier unsevered quality into the focus promise. Alternatively, 68:3 may define only the addressee's recompense.

changed_reading.before: The plural gardens merely increase the quantity of the owners' lost garden.
changed_reading.after: They also change its temporality: unlike a hoarded plot consumed by harvest and severance, this bounty is not ended by cutting.

context_deltas.mechanism: The demanded mutual softening of 68:9 is accommodation that oils over a moral boundary. Focus self-guarding refuses that counterfeit softness, while the softness and ease within النعيم become its non-compromising counterpart.

activation_trace.role: Soft social accommodation supplies the false ease offered through mutual compromise.
Self-protective caution supplies the boundary that cannot be oiled away.
Real softness and ease become the eventual condition rather than the method of compromise.

structural_cues: 68:9 presents reciprocal softening as the deniers' wish; 68:34 reserves ease for those named by guarding.
The focus relocates softness from negotiation to destination.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies distinct social and material softness images; I infer a reversal between means and end. They may instead be unrelated beyond tactile analogy.

changed_reading.before: Guarding and bliss oppose hardness and pleasure generically.
changed_reading.after: The guarded refuse lubricated compromise so genuine softness can be received as life rather than purchased by surrender.

context_deltas.mechanism: The garden owners convert a cultivated enclosure into a social barrier: they withhold good, plan a secret harvest, and forbid a dependent person's entry. Their possession becomes reciprocal deprivation. The focus distinguishes taqwa's barrier against harm from a hoarder's barrier against another person.

activation_trace.role: Holding the hand back from giving supplies the vice later enacted by the owners.
The singular tree-covered enclosure supplies the possessed garden whose boundary is misused.
Harvest cutting supplies extraction timed to precede any claim by the poor.
Entry into an interior makes access to the enclosure the ethical test.
Poverty and dependence identify the vulnerable entrant intended for exclusion.
Deprivation turns the owners' intended exclusion back upon them.
Warding harm with a barrier supplies the legitimate boundary distinguished from withholding.
Plural enclosures become the transformed destination after the singular enclosure fails its access test.

structural_cues: 68:17-27 moves from owning a garden, to preventing entry, to the owners naming themselves deprived.
68:34 changes singular الجنة to plural جنات and controlling owners to recipients عند ربهم.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies barrier, withholding, entry, cutting, and reciprocal deprivation; I infer that the focus tests what protection protects against and whom it excludes. The alternative is a simpler contrast of character.

changed_reading.before: Taqwa is a stronger version of keeping danger and claimants outside one's enclosure.
changed_reading.after: Taqwa protects without becoming possessive exclusion: the barrier faces harm, not the dependent person, and the garden is received rather than hoarded.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus locates concealed gardens 'with their Lord'; 68:47 asks whether the unseen is instead 'with them' so they can write binding outcomes. The mirrored proximity construction turns عند ربهم into exclusive custody, knowledge, and authority over the hidden future.

activation_trace.role: Presence and proximity locate the promise within the Lord's domain.
Concealment permits the gardens to be real and near while absent from present sight.
The same proximity is reassigned to challengers in a question denying their custody.
What is screened from eyes names the hidden domain whose possession is contested.
Writing that fixes judgment supplies the authority falsely inferred from possessing the unseen.

structural_cues: 68:34 says عند ربهم; 68:47 mirrors it with عندهم الغيب.
The second construction is interrogative and followed by writing, making the contrast jurisdictional.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies mirrored عند phrases, concealment, and decree-writing; I infer that the locative marks rightful custody. It may instead be ordinary possession without a designed mirror.

changed_reading.before: 'With their Lord' is ornamental piety attached to future reward.
changed_reading.after: It denies human authorship of the hidden verdict: the gardens are present in the Lord's custody, not available for opponents to inspect or script.

context_deltas.mechanism: In 68:49 favor catches a person before he is cast into an uncovered expanse; in 68:50 the Lord makes him into a new moral company. The covered garden becomes the opposite of exposure, while the guarded can be people preserved and re-formed by care rather than an untouched elite.

activation_trace.role: Catching and reaching someone supplies grace's interruptive rescue before exposure.
Bestowed favor is the rescuer and directly reconnects the episode to النعيم.
Open space without cover supplies the threatened anti-garden.
Making something enter a new state supplies post-rescue formation.
Repair and completion connect rescue to the Lord named as custodian.
Protective cover makes the garden the material inverse of the bare expanse.

structural_cues: 68:49 places نعمة between near-disaster and العراء; 68:50 follows with remaking.
The focus uses the same favor root for a covered destination and the same Lord relation.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies rescue, favor, exposure, remaking, and garden-cover; I infer restoration leading into the focus category. The episode may alternatively remain specific to prophetic rescue.

changed_reading.before: Already-complete righteous people receive gardens as external payment.
changed_reading.after: The promise can include a rescue ecology: favor catches the exposed, the Lord repairs them, and garden-cover becomes their re-placement.

context_deltas.mechanism: The Lord makes the rescued figure one of the صالحين, while a focus branch of النعيم images a place agreeing with its settler. Formation is two-sided: the person is made fit and the garden is fitted to that person.

activation_trace.role: Causing a new condition makes moral fitness achieved, not only prior.
Suitability supplies the person-side of the congruence.
A place agreeing with its inhabitant supplies the habitat-side.
Nurture and completion provide the process bringing person and place into fit.

structural_cues: 68:50 ends with divine making into the صالحين; 68:34 names destination through congenial settlement.
Both transformations remain attached to رب.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies two suitability images and divine making; I infer reciprocal fit. A live alternative restricts صالحين to rectitude and النعيم to pleasure.

changed_reading.before: Moral qualification merely earns a ready-made paradise.
changed_reading.after: Divine nurture makes inhabitants fit for a habitat itself fitted to them; qualification and destination answer one another.

context_deltas.mechanism: Lord-nurture and ease coexist with a rival slow process in 68:44-45: taking degree by degree while granting extended time under a firm plan. This distinguishes genuine completion from comfortable delay that is actually capture; ease alone cannot identify النعيم.

activation_trace.role: Taking degree by degree supplies the deceptive developmental trajectory.
Extended time and respite supply apparent ease within which capture unfolds.
Extended hardness and solidity make the hidden plan durable beneath respite.
Stagewise nurture and completion supply the constructive gradual process.
Easeful living is the surface condition whose source and direction must be tested.

structural_cues: 68:44-45 joins unrecognized gradual taking to respite; 68:34 joins ease to nearness under Lordship.
Both are extended conditions with opposed endpoints.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies nurture, stepwise taking, respite, and firmness; I infer opposed temporal processes beneath similar ease. The punishment process may alternatively leave النعيم untouched.

changed_reading.before: Any prolonged ease can be evidence of favor, and the garden is its maximal form.
changed_reading.after: True bliss is ease directed toward completion in divine nearness; prolonged comfort directed toward capture is its counterfeit.

context_deltas.mechanism: Hostile eyes almost make the addressee slip from his station. That scene activates guarded hoof-placement: the muttaقين preserve footing under social force, and their destination is a place that finally holds them well.

activation_trace.role: A smooth place on which the foot cannot remain supplies threatened loss of station.
Literal eyesight identifies the hostile gaze associated with destabilization.
A gait guarded against hoof pain supplies the bodily counter-practice preserving footing.
A congenial place supplies the stable opposite of terrain that will not hold a foot.

structural_cues: 68:51 joins hostile sight, near-slippage, hearing the reminder, and renewed madness accusation.
The focus names people whose inventory contains a guarded-gait image.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies slippage and a form-distant guarded-hoof branch; I transfer them to ethical stability. The live alternative keeps يزلقونك as attack without connecting it to متقين.

changed_reading.before: The muttaقين are statically protected people awaiting a static place.
changed_reading.after: They keep footing under a gaze that would dislodge them until they reach a habitat where footing and dwelling agree.

context_deltas.mechanism: The owners call themselves harvest-cutters, then after the focus the text asks whether muslims should be made like criminals. A branch of جرم means cutting alongside guilt. The focus becomes a hinge refusing to equate the sound/whole with those whose acquisition is figured as cutting.

activation_trace.role: Harvest cutting supplies the owners' extractive role.
Safety and freedom from defect supply the intact side of the comparison.
Cutting creates a branch-level echo between criminality and harvest economy.
Guilt keeps the cutting echo attached to the explicit moral category.
Vigorous growth supplies the whole living system placed between cutters and comparison.

structural_cues: 68:34 is the hinge between the cut-off garden's punishment and the 68:35 comparison.
صرم and مجرمين independently carry cutting images.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies different cutting roots, immediate sequence, and guilt; I infer an extractive echo, not etymological identity. مجرمين may instead be only the standard moral label.

changed_reading.before: The focus is a detachable promise between punishment and a general equality question.
changed_reading.after: It declares that intact, guarded life cannot share the end of an extractive cutting economy, even when both stand near a garden.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: Surprising because it uses the packet's non-dominant ر ب و mapping for focus رَبِّ rather than ordinary parsing. It remains anchored to that focus occurrence and converges with dominant nurture and garden growth; render only as secondary root-map resonance, never as the direct gloss of رَبِّ.

activation_trace.role: Nourishing and growing up from the split mapped root supplies exploratory maturation.
Dominant-root repair and completion keep the resonance attached to a clean mechanism.
Vigorous plant growth gives maturation a visible garden anchor.

changed_reading.before: The Lord only possesses finished reward and finished recipients.
changed_reading.after: As contained resonance, Lordship also appears as maturation of people and gardens into completion.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: Surprising because the cloud branch attached to رب is form-distant and no cloud is explicit in 68:34. It remains a packet-backed ecological analogy joined to the garden and 68:19's encircling visitation; mark it as atmospheric resonance, not a claim that رب means cloud here.

activation_trace.role: An encircling flood supplies the weather-like process stripping the owners' garden.
A low layered cloud supplies ecological ambiguity: nurture or ruin.
The same branch, retained only as resonance, places promised gardens under weather-like care.
Vigorous growth anchors the atmospheric analogy in focus ecology.

changed_reading.before: The gardens are static property insulated from ecological contingency.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, they are living systems flourishing through right relation to the sovereignty that can also strip a hoarded garden.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: Surprising because it activates a courtesy formula about the gladdened eye from النعيم and crosses it with separate sight scenes. It stays anchored in the focus root and repeated eye imagery; render as sensory-affective echo, not lexical translation.

activation_trace.role: The formula of an eye gladdened by another supplies an affective-visual edge to bliss.
Literal eyesight supplies the humbled gaze needing reversal.
Literal eyesight also supplies the hostile gaze trying to destabilize another.

changed_reading.before: Bliss is private pleasure unrelated to damaged uses of sight.
changed_reading.after: As contained resonance, bliss repairs vision: the gaze no longer humiliates or dislodges but becomes gladdened in relation.

strongest_changes: Protective caution became garden-cover, then the owners' story distinguished protection from exclusionary hoarding.
The favor/Lord/covering triad moved from denied mind-veiling in 68:2 to beneficial cultivated concealment in 68:34.
Uncut recompense and harvest-severance changed the gardens from more property into bounty with unsevered temporality.
The mirror between عند ربهم and عندهم الغيب made divine custody of the hidden verdict part of the promise.
Rescue from bare exposure and threatened slippage made the guarded restored, formed, and footing-conscious rather than merely prequalified.
summary.what_was_special: The focus became a reversal hinge for cover, cut, entry, exposure, nearness, softness, and footing. Garden as shelter, relation, fitted ecology, uncut duration, restored placement, and stable footing remain coexisting readings.
remaining_uncertainties: The non-dominant ر ب و mapping is only contained resonance; its intentional relevance cannot be established.
The صرم/جرم cutting echo is abductively strong in sequence but may not be deliberate wordplay.
The fitted-place and gladdened-eye branches may support evocative prose more securely than lexical exposition.
Reward for an already guarded group and divine formation into that group remain live together.
